text:
sam (pm): heads-up: Competitor Z announced EmbedLite this AM. price is ~0.0006 per 768-d, claims "parity" on public bench. saw customer threads asking for a cheap index tier. :eyes:
maria: thanks. can we get a read on how close parity is and whether it's just a pricing play?
olivia: did a quick smoke test on three internal search sets. top-10 precision delta ~1.8% on avg; some edge queries drop more. their demo is faster but uses 8-bit quant and different pooling. i'll drop the notebook.
lee (data): i can run a larger sample overnight and compute business-impact metrics (click-through proxy, recall@k loss cost estimate). should have numbers tomorrow.
raj: engineering note: to match price we probably need a quantized/lightweight model + dedicated routing + smaller batch pipeline. infra changes non-trivial: separate autoscaler, image, and perf tuning. ballpark: 6-8 weeks from spike to GA including perf validation.
taylor: product choices: 1) price-match with a non-SLA "budget" embedding tier, 2) keep current pricing but add stronger analytics & evals to emphasize quality, or 3) hybrid: launch a limited "embed-lite" with strict guardrails (canary + per-tenant rollback).
dina (sales): customers keep asking for a trial-priced low-cost index option. sales will push a simple per-request budget SKU rather than complicated feature toggles. short-term wins matter.
maria: if we consider option 1 or 3 we need crisp launch criteria. propose: - quality delta (precision@10) <= 2.0% vs default - 95p latency <= 150ms for hosted tier - effective unit cost <= $0.00075 per 768-d - auto-fallback for tenant when quality drop >5% for 30m - limit availability to hosted API and free-trial accounts initially
lee (data): suggest add: holdout suite with adversarial shards + periodic drift detector. log signal: retrieval_success and downstream CTR proxy.
olivia: agree. and add a small manual review pool for edge-case queries during the canary window.
raj: canary plan sketch:
```
0-48h: 1% traffic, monitor retrieval_success, avg cos sim delta, latency.
48-96h: 10% traffic if stable.
96-168h: 25% traffic.
auto-disable on per-tenant threshold breach.
```
ben (ops): deploying lite pool will need 2 GPU nodes for canary + separate cache strategy. also tokenization overhead differs; include token-cost meter.
taylor: GTM guardrails: offer as non-SLA, no Dedicated/Private support on launch, opt-out for enterprise customers. pricing table draft: $0.00065 / 768-d for first 100M, then tiered.
dina (sales): i'll validate price points with three enterprise trials and feed back acceptable thresholds.
maria: timeline & owners: olivia + lee = bench + adversarial sets by EOD Thurs; raj + ben = infra spike + rough rollout plan by next Tue; taylor = draft pricing + docs for sales by Mon; dina = customer thresholds inline by Mon. sync Wed 10am for go/no-go.
olivia: one more ask: include a tight monitoring dashboard and alert for signal drift; i'll sketch metrics.
raj: also include a rollback SLA: if tenant sees >5% retrieval drop sustained for 1 hour, route back to default model automatically. implement as routing policy flag.
deploy-bot: canary resource request created (2 x g4dn) pending approval.
maria: thanks all. keep this thread updated with any leaked competitor tech notes or perf artifacts. :thumbsup:
